title: Makes bacon in shape of a bowl
text:
Makes bacon in shape of a bowl. First of all it takes a little experimenting to get the Perfect Bacon Bowl down. I still don't have it down to a science after making about 20 bacon bowls over the course of 3 days. (Rouse's had 3 lbs cheap generic brand bacon on sale for $4.99). This allowed me to come up with a few techniques.

I recommend spraying the bowls with a non-stick spray before laying down the first strip of bacon. Makes them much easier to remove from the bowl. Really, that's the only technique and it was already printed in the instructions.

Second, bacon from a microwave is not bacon. If you are using these bowls, cooking bacon in a microwave and complaining about it, the problem is not the bacon or the bowl -- it's you.

Finally, there's really not much going on with these bowls. Sure you can come up with a few recipes and get creative, but we're talking about bacon here. It's not going to last long once it is cooking and the scent is in the air. I found myself eating bacon shaped like a bowl 3 nights in a row, sharing lots with my dog for training purposes.
